reserveReview.rationale: Issuer API source 2026-10-07T08:00:19.096Z, accessed 2026-10-07T20:47:18.580729Z, reports $15,537,989.483383574 reserves and 15,275,117.334802557 USDO with a 101.7209% ratio. Positive constituents normalize to TBILL 78.95194721%, BUIDL 9.64028307%, RLUSD 8.62380556%, VBILL 2.63169331%, and USDC 0.15227084%. USYC, BENJI, pending-USDC and uAmount are observed zero and create no positive holdings. The ratio reconciles only reported usdoAmount, not every queued claim; pendingReserverAssetsRedeem and gap fields are unresolved context, not additional inventory. This is issuer accounting, not independent financial assurance or proof of redemption openness. Chainlink feed coverage measured 2026-10-19: Chainlink's Base feed directory lists the usdo-por feed (proxy 0x5218ebeb96bd2bafe21f9b143f5672552629ba79) with reserve asset U.S. Treasury Bills and porSource Wallet Address Manager. At Base block 52817725 its latestRoundData answer was 14,188,778.570757 (18 decimals), updated 2026-10-19T00:03:33Z. The issuer API snapshot dated 2026-10-19T08:00:18.584Z reported $15,556,010.22 reserves against 15,256,774.83 USDO; TBILL ($12,252,338.73), BUIDL ($1,499,432.10) and VBILL ($409,325.00) total $14,161,095.83, and the RLUSD and USDC buffer $1,394,914.39. The feed answer therefore sits below USDO supply and close to the Treasury-fund holdings alone, consistent with a feed that excludes the stablecoin buffer; it is not a full-basket reserve figure and should not be read as a reserve-to-supply ratio.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden states that USDO reserve assets and liabilities are held in a segregated account of a Bermuda segregated-accounts company and are insulated from claims against other accounts. The current reserve API identifies asset holdings but not the account-level custodians, provider shares, underlying fund custody chains, or rehypothecation terms.
